title: Install the actual QQ16 caller with a complete return and protocol bill
body:
## Result and scope

[PR #4129](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4129) supplies exact recursive C calls on an admitted prepared ABI; it does not install an actual QQ16 caller. This package connects the actual selected first F0/B1 producer to a paid encoded 448-family recovery service, reconstructs all 224 current outputs in their required owner-dependent frames, publishes them with exclusive storage, and resumes both legs of the named source bridge. This is one conditional **class B enabling mechanism**, not an affordable supplier or a new exponent.

`connection.install` attaches the changed binding to the actual `RootLayer.fast_core` before input, retaining its old original C Machine as a separately closed backend. Only source events 0 and 4 change their arithmetic; events 1–3 remain ordered. Recovery enters after the whole-cover B fence 573, followed by original idle5 and bridge6. Descendants use the unchanged original C binding. No original input or private query is imported at the fence.

The prepared-input/storage/current-frame premises beyond [PR #4129](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4129) are replaced by source-bound mechanisms: actual whole-family acquisition, encoded descriptor and stock checks, separate producer/service/native inventories, all 224 signed D calls, 112 negative current-return lines, full borrowed-field verification, output preflight, publication and retirement. The current endpoint is the actual selected `G(x,y)=(-y,x+y)`, not a centre-free endpoint substituted for it.

Read [PROOF.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b082d22a0e9a442d264ab0633e35ef26c790630/research/qq16-caller-install/PROOF.md), [ADMISSION.json](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b082d22a0e9a442d264ab0633e35ef26c790630/research/qq16-caller-install/ADMISSION.json) and [COST.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b082d22a0e9a442d264ab0633e35ef26c790630/research/qq16-caller-install/COST.md). Component proofs, source manifests, exact compatibility decisions and executable receipts are in the same package.

## Complete comparison and decision

The new adapter changes **every root child-call protocol**, including retained and later calls. The bill explicitly keeps original parent parking/embedded C/restore separate from external `Machine.run` copying/root return and does not cancel them from equal ranks or values.

| Child occurrences per Γ | Original | Installed |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Entry through source bridge6 | 17,565 | 17,581 plus 336 service |
| Later source suffix | 493,097 | 493,097 with changed call protocol |
| Whole root | 510,662 | 510,678 plus 336 service |

The full source-derived operation sum includes acquisition, encoded arithmetic, actual packet widths/geometries, full-bank scans, four physical monomial calls per signed line, scalar work, protected copies, all engine inventories, output movement and disposal. No unknown cost is zero. `BILL.json` independently binds the compiler's census and the complete root protocol partition.

There is a constructive local improvement: adopting the completed internal bank costs `9B+26` cell actions versus the same installation's fixed-copy `20B+30`, saving **11B+4** (`B` is the complete parent-bank bit length), less any separately priced finite-selector control `c_R`. All internal current bindings are updated; public ports stay fixed. This adapts [PR #3380](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3380) with a new physical-role proof and bill, rather than importing its different saving.

The isolated native-component comparison adds 368 C1 against 16 C8 removed, ratio at least 23/8 under its specified common homogeneous charge. Even a free final native repair leaves 256 C1 versus 128 C1 credit. This **does not settle total physical affordability**: avoiding original parent parking on510646Γ retained calls may supply a compensating credit. The next discriminating experiment is paired source protocol pricing at actual complete bank/packet geometry, including descendant contexts and the later suffix, against the added routing/service bill.

Selected κ remains exactly `836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918`.

## Verification and limits

- Registered Python 3.12 package replay, including complete typed receipts, ordinary/optimized Git-free read-only export tests, source-before-execution refusal, descriptor/word/manifest corruption, typed receipt/duplicate controls and exclusive generation.
- Full selected finite compilation, both complete 24,767-event source shadows, all 336 signed 73D recipe bindings, whole-root census, actual 46-body range/debt calculation and exact all-parameter sufficient fine-grid inequality.
- Actual reduced physical producer → whole-cover fence → encoded acquisition → recovery/original C → current G → publication → both bridge legs; two different generations on the same engines, all 64 complex outputs checked.
- Nonsymmetric O3 owner-cycle and both-signed native-conjugation tests (192 complex values each), full 224-field packing/lifecycle, dirty state, borrowed preservation, premature reuse/alias/descriptor/nonleaf rejection and cleanup inspected before fixture recovery.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight and authenticated committed export; ordinary and optimized replay with no Git or executable search path and unchanged read-only export contents.

The post-remainder admission guard and nonsymmetric owner tests resolved real interface defects. Final assisted adversarial review reports no unresolved blocking scientific/composition defect at the hash-bound snapshot in `REVIEW.json`. Shared sources/primitives are disclosed; this is not independent human acceptance or formal-kernel verification. Hosted CI is a separate publication status. Local registered checks passed at commit `0b082d22a0e9a442d264ab0633e35ef26c790630`; four boundary tests passed in301.027s. The authenticated official export contained133 committed source/package files plus its manifest; ordinary and optimized cold replays passed in150.110s and 153.804s with empty stderr, no Git/PATH and byte-identical read-only contents.

Production O73 numerical payloads and complete `RootLayer.run` were not executed. The all-size theorem retains exact original C/native/common-label/hosting, source-entry height, ordinary B1/C0, Compact, long-record and admitted root/row-stock hypotheses. Logical coarse width, native reserve, physical width and address guard remain distinct. The selected installation retains actual fine quantum and H_b; the auxiliary PΓ whole-family validation block is distinct from actual P-prefix per-owner native capsules. There is no all-node modified recursion or new supplier/bootstrap admission.

[Canonical claim/history](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3985#issuecomment-6263114494). Overlap covered bounded all-stateQQ16 top25, quoted [PR #4129](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4129) query, named heads/reviews and Discussion1163/1166/index. New [PR #4162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4162) adjacent ADD/frame and [PR #4149](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4149) ADDRESS work has different scope. Helper remote coverage was unavailable; bounded searches are not novelty certificates.
